units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 95b:16">Snh. 95ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ההוא גברא בההוא פ׳ נמי יתיב</he> this man, too, lives in that fear, i.e. that is the very thing that troubles me.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 66b:7">B. Mets. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>דילמא לפכוחי פַחְדֵּיה קא שתי</he> perhaps he drinks to break his fear (to get courage)?; <cite ref="Taanit 13b:5">Taan. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>פחודיה</he> some ed. (corr. acc.).—[V. <cite ref="Q00450"><he>פַּחְדִּין</he></cite>.]
